model_selection: Final EMA after4000 updates; no intermediate checkpoint selection.
primary: Fixed full candidate versus the original method and the same-update continuation control on the existing64-composition benchmark, all-output geometry-plus-force yield.
secondary: Geometry plus GFN2 RMS force<=5, graph validity, force distribution, per-composition distinct valid connectivity, heavy connectivity and individual geometry failures.
advancement: Joint geometry-plus-force gains in both fits and composition95CI lower bound>0 against physical-only and geometry-only; all separate metrics retained. Exploratory combination, not independent confirmation.
scope: Benchmark re-evaluation after choosing the intervention on the separate24-composition development panel. The64-composition benchmark was used in earlier work and is not a new blind test. Reuse its original fit0/1 corrected-FM outputs and audited force scores. Candidate models and all strengths are fixed before their benchmark outputs. No geometry optimization or sampling energy queries.

statistics.unit: composition, preserving paired draws and retaining both fits; all fit-specific contrasts reported

parent_selection: recovery_local final EMA for both fits; chosen for consistent point gains on the development panel; its conservative pilot advancement gate was false and is retained.
geometry_selection: radial_geometry final EMA for both fits; highest pooled geometry-plus-force yield in direct-field development study, no angle-specific claim.

method_labels.full_geometry_physics: Recovery-trained FM with geometry and physical fields
